label: mesh-stable-identity
context:
Fixed mesh plugin to use stable agent identity instead of PID-based identity. Previously os.getpid() was used as default agent ID, which changed on every execute_code call, creating phantom duplicate agents in the mesh.

Changes:
1. Replaced _AGENT_ID = os.environ.get("HERMES_MESH_ID", f"agent-{os.getpid()}") with _stable_agent_id() function
2. _stable_agent_id() uses 3-tier lookup: HERMES_MESH_ID env var → ~/.hermes/.mesh-identity file → hash of hostname+username
3. Identity file pre-created: ~/.hermes/.mesh-identity contains "agent-dannygomez-b20137a0"
4. _get_session_id() also patched to not use PID
5. DB cleaned — all stale duplicate entries removed from presence/activity/messages tables
6. Plugin __pycache__ cleared

Also done this session:
- Added register(ctx) to mesh plugin with 4 tool registrations (mesh_status, mesh_message, mesh_task, mesh_lock)
- Fixed distillation plugin — pre_tool_call hook now loads (was stale .pyc cache)
- Both plugins confirmed working in gateway.log at 16:09:53
- plugin.yaml files fixed for both plugins (provides_hooks declarations)
